data.name: Lord Pengu: Glacier Ward
data.description: Lord Pengu summons a barrier of enchanted ice, reducing incoming damage from the opponent for a short duration.
data.battleDescription: With a dignified squawk, Lord Pengu slams his flipper into the snow, sending ripples of frosty chakra into the earth. Shimmering spires of glacier-forged ice erupt around %user, forming a semi-transparent dome that pulses with ancient cold. As attacks from %target strike, the barrier absorbs and disperses the energy, muffling impacts with a crystalline chime. For a few precious moments, %user becomes an immovable bastion, protected by the Tundra King’s will. While active, damage from %target is significantly reduced, allowing time for retaliation or retreat.

With a powerful belly-slide that churns snow into glittering frost shards, %user commands Pengu into a thunderous impact. The moment of contact erupts in a burst of freezing chakra, locking %target’s limbs in a shimmering sheath of frost. For a breathless second, time seems to halt—the tundra’s might made manifest in a single dazzling strike. Frozen in place, %target is left stunned and vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: AI JUTSU Nightmare Cascade
data.description: Traps the enemy in a cascade of endless nightmares.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes gleam with a malevolent light as they begin weaving the hand seals, their voice whispering dark incantations that seem to echo in %target’s mind. As the final seal is formed, the world around %target begins to warp and twist, plunging them into a nightmare realm created by %user. Within this realm, %target is assaulted by their deepest fears and darkest memories, each one more horrifying than the last. The Nightmare Cascade forces %target to relive these nightmares endlessly, weakening their spirit and resolve with every cycle. %user watches with cold satisfaction as their opponent's mind unravels, leaving them vulnerable to further manipulation or a final, devastating strike.
